uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1887-3099-4762-8320.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Yoshimaru and Vorinclex.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

1651-2034-3263-5261-8116.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting Frontline Rush without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Frontline Rush, creating two creature tokens that are also artifacts due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping both creature tokens, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing one creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped tokens, you may sacrifice any number of them to add infinite colorless mana.

1651-4231-4365-4732-5261.notablePrerequisites: You control another artifact or creature.
1651-4231-4365-4732-5261.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it to cast a copy of Deadly Dispute without paying its mana cost.
As an additional cost to cast Deadly Dispute, sacrifice a creature or artifact.
Resolve Deadly Dispute, drawing two cards and creating two Food tokens, two Clue tokens, and two Treasure tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Mondrak.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them to add {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two untapped artifacts you control to untap Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

4091-5821-7791.description:
Activate Fyndhorn Elder by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Fyndhorn Elder.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Fyndhorn Elder.
Repeat.

1303-1574-1769.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Rot Hulk enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot-Tide Gargantua from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Rot-Tide Gargantua enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Resolve the Rot-Tide Gargantua trigger, sacrificing it.
When Rot-Tide Gargantua is exploited, Rot-Tide Gargantua triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Rot-Tide Gargantua.
When the token Rot-Tide Gargantua enters, it triggers, sacrificing Rot Hulk.
When Rot Hulk is exploited, Rot-Tide Gargantua triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

101-4050-7364.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Vampire Charmseeker and another nontoken creature, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Continue? by paying {1}{W}, returning Vampire Charmseeker and at least one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Continue? from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-4050-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to two additional creatures each loop to net mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4585-6797-6972.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three total creatures on the battlefield.
4585-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Custodi Soulbinders.
When Custodi Soulbinders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2366-3512-4359-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3512-4359-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

225-539-1662-4518.description:
Activate Karoo by tapping it, adding {C}{W}.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
When Kor Skyfisher enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Karoo.
Repeat.

147-5147-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 5.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2275-3591-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have a card in hand.
392-2275-3591-6282.description:
Activate Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
Resolve all Harnfel abilities.

647-1563-2457-4365.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

359-1621-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver.
359-1621-4605.description:
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
Wispweaver Angel and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another creature you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-2792-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
2438-2792-5140.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Great Whale, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat.

586-2350-5256-5258-5618.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Priest of Gix's power.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2540-3430-5137.notablePrerequisites:
Morphling does not have summoning sickness.
Morphling has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2540-3430-5137.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Morphling's first ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1643-2073-3459-4050.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Clown Car enters the battlefield, triggering Battered Golem, untapping Battered Golem.
Activate Clown Car's crew ability by tapping Battered Golem, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Clown Car, adding one mana of any color.
Clown Car dies, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

2104-2493-5163.notablePrerequisites: Roon does not have summoning sickness.
2104-2493-5163.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Roon by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling Archaeomancer until the beginning of your end step.
At the beginning of your end step, Roon triggers, returning Archaeomancer from exile to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, putting Temporal Manipulation into your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

104-2290.easyPrerequisites:
Spike Feeder has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
Cleric Class is at least level two.
104-2290.description:
Activate Spike Feeder by removing a +1/+1 counter from it to gain two life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Spike Feeder.
Repeat.

618-2816-4414-5313.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control at least three additional creatures.
618-2816-4414-5313.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Goldnight Redeemer with haste.
The token enters gaining you at least 10 life.
Pay 9 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}.
Pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
